# Saabai

> Saabai (ABN 71 889 082 572) is a Gold Coast, Queensland business (Merrimac QLD 4226, Australia) founded by Shane Goldberg. All prices are in AUD. Saabai is not GST registered (GST not applicable).

## Products

- [Website care plans](https://www.saabai.ai/websites): Saabai builds, hosts and manages small business websites with an AI enquiry chatbot built in. Care plans: Presence $100/month, Growth $200/month, Signature $300/month. Builds start from $2,000.
- [Saabai Blueprint AI audit](https://www.saabai.ai/blueprint): a ranked AI plan showing where AI saves hours and dollars. Starter $497 (within 48 hours), Pro $1,497 (3 business days, reviewed by Shane, 30 min walkthrough), Business $3,500 (2 to 3 weeks, team discovery, 12 month roadmap). Fee credited if you build with Saabai within 30 days.
- [Free AI Readiness Score](https://www.saabai.ai/score): a free 3 minute, 12 question quiz with an instant score out of 100 and three quick wins.
- [Lex](https://www.saabai.ai/legal): an AI legal assistant for Australian law firms. It cites ATO rulings and Commonwealth legislation. The Firm plan is $299 a month.
- [Custom AI chatbots](https://www.saabai.ai/ai-chatbot-developer-queensland): custom AI chatbots for Queensland business websites. A website chatbot is included in the care plans above. A custom build is quoted on a call.
- [Custom AI agents](https://www.saabai.ai/custom-ai-agents): agents that answer questions. Quoting and follow-up are custom work, quoted to the job. Book a call for a quote.
- [AI chatbot for law firms](https://www.saabai.ai/ai-chatbot-law-firms): custom AI chatbots for Australian law firms, plus Lex. The chatbot answers after-hours enquiries and keeps a log of the chat. Enquiry alerts are coming soon.
- [AI receptionist for Gold Coast businesses](https://www.saabai.ai/ai-receptionist-gold-coast): a website chatbot for Gold Coast businesses. Included in the website tiers, from $2,000 plus $100 a month care. Answers enquiries 24/7 and keeps a log of each chat. Enquiry alerts are coming soon.
- [SEO and AI search visibility](https://www.saabai.ai/seo-ai-search): included in every Blueprint, from $497. Checks Google, ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Gemini.
- [LeadGen](https://www.saabai.ai/leadgen): AI lead capture for service businesses. Starter $197/month, Pro $397/month, Enterprise $997/month.
- [Pricing](https://www.saabai.ai/pricing): the published prices collected on one page.
